notes.subject: ol ⟨indaunde⟩
notes.rationale: קִיד suffix '-ם' points back to the cedars of v5; Tok Pisin needs the object named.

notes.subject: שִׂרְיֹן Sirion
notes.rationale: Sirion appears only here (elsewhere Siryon/Hermon names differ); name kept as-is.

notes.subject: wail bulmakau
notes.rationale: רְאֵם is a wild ox (aurochs), not a domestic bulmakau; 'wail' keeps the difference.

translation: Em i mekim ol ⟨indaunde⟩ long kago olsem pikinini bulmakau; Lebnon na Sirion olsem pikinini bilong ol wail bulmakau.

tokens.gloss: Em i mekim ol ⟨indaunde⟩ long kago
